resources.string: Show how the completion rate is calculated
Rounded to the nearest whole percent.

Uses historical schedules and saved runs in the 30 days ending yesterday, including the creation date. Disabled, ongoing and unscheduled days without records are excluded. Skipped and unanswered scheduled runs count toward the denominator.
Shown after at least 3 eligible runs. Schedules, names and colors before history tracking are estimated from the initial settings. Saved runs are preserved; later edits do not change this baseline.
